findings.summary: A held commit is pushed without its GO verdict when the commit message contains a line that starts with '---'. push_recursive.sh trailer() (line 176) reads Awaits-Review through 'git interpret-trailers --parse', and git stops looking for trailers at the first line that starts with '---' (it treats that line as a patch divider). The trailers that commit_recursive.sh appends after the message are then not found, so the commit counts as unheld and is pushed. The CPA-commit predicate (lib_safe cpa_runid) and integrate_merge.sh:245 scan the whole message with awk, so they still accept the commit as a CPA commit. That is two models of one fact: the trailer class that WF17 meant to close (MODEL/MSG-1). S0 (commit-push-all.sh:280) refuses only message lines that look like trailers, not '---' lines. Other members of the same class: the Foreign-Commit dedupe through %(trailers) in commit_recursive.sh:137 and integrate_merge.sh:267, and trailer(CPA-Run) returning an empty run id.

---

notes'): 2 ok, 0 failed. R1 (message 'held work
---

findings.remediation: Use one trailer parser for every reader: the CPA-Run predicate, Awaits-Review, Foreign-Commit and integrate_merge. Alternatively, refuse at S0 any message line that starts with '---', and in either case check that the parsed trailer block contains the CPA-Run line commit_recursive wrote, and refuse 20 if it does not (fail closed). Add the R1 case to the matrix and a paired mutation.

findings.summary: No test covers the documented rule 'while U holds an unreleased merge commit nothing of U is pushed to any remote' (push_recursive.sh header) in the case where the held merge sits after unheld outgoing commits (cut>0). Reviewer mutation mB replaced '[ "$mergeblock" = 1 ] && [ "$cut" -gt 0 ] && target=' with 'false && target='. It survived the helper suite test_push_recursive.sh (153 ok / 0 failed) and matrix section '7 merge' of test_commit_push_all.sh (90 ok / 0 failed, CPA_SRC pointing at the mutated copy; the harness seeds scripts/repo/*.sh from $SRC, test_commit_push_all.sh:56). Positive control for the helper-suite injection path: reviewer mutation mA, described in mutations_attempted, was CAUGHT.

The T044 acceptance (matrix under kcov in IMG-KCOV and shellcheck in IMG-SHELLCHECK, transcripts naming image digests) is not met for the reviewed bytes. cpa-kcov.txt (2026-10-06) and cpa-shellcheck.txt (sha256 of commit-push-all.sh 59a53a65...) measure an older revision than the reviewed one (e39e9949...). fix-r5-shellcheck.txt used the host binary and says the pinned-image run is owed. fix-r5-convergence.md says kcov was not rerun.

The fix-round-5 bytes of commit-push-all.sh and its helpers reached main in 58cb30b8 'Auto-commit' (git log -- scripts/commit-push-all.sh). That commit was not made through CPA, had no independent review first (11.4.142), and carries no CPA-Run or attribution trailer. Any adoption under T047 must account for this commit and review the exact bytes it introduced.

When scripts/audit/own_orgs.txt is missing from the approved copy (OWNED is empty), the main repository is pushed to every url and push url of every remote with no ownership check: commit-push-all.sh:315 skips the gate and push_recursive gets no --owned-orgs. Submodules, by contrast, are then never pushed. INSTALL.md documents this, but a push with an unverifiable precondition fails open, against 11.4.252. Suggest refusing 20 when the approved list is missing.

In lib_safe.sh repo_config_gate, 'git config --local --list --name-only -z' runs inside a process substitution with 2>/dev/null, so its exit status is lost. A failing listing reads as 'no keys' and the gate passes. This is the LIST class the author closed elsewhere through listing() and gitlinks_ok. Separately, integrate_merge.sh --resolution runs 'git merge --no-ff --no-commit' and 'merge --abort' on the working tree (line 157) before the 9.2 backup is written (line 178 onward). Today the path always ends in secret_fold_unavailable, but the order is wrong for when that fold is built.

The vocabularies conflict. contracts/review-verdict.schema.json makes finding_layer {source, artifact, runtime}, while constitution 11.4.235(D) and the T046 instructions use finding_layer {source-defect, test-instrumentation, process-doc}. A review cannot satisfy both with one field. Also carried from the author's own notes and still open: the real origin push URLs name milos85vasic, which own_orgs.txt does not list, so the first real run stops at S0 until the owner decides (11.4.66).
